Name: Mushroom Paths
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Adds two mushroom paths to the game!

[b]IF USING CONTENT PATCHER[/b]

This mod entirely replaces the Stepping Stone Path (except for the menu icon). You can only use either the path with or without the mushrooms. In order to enable the smaller mushrooms, run the game with the mod once, and then go to the config.json and change "MushroomSize" config option to "small"

Config Options:
Mushroom Size: big, small

[b]IF USING ALTERNATIVE TEXTURES:[/b]

This mod is a texture for the Stepping Stone Path. When placing, it will randomly select between the original texture and the two mushroom textures. You can change which texture is used with the paint bucket tool.

[b]IF USING CUSTOMPATHS:[/b]

Both paths can be bought at Robin's and are very similar. One includes small mushrooms, one does not.

WARNING IF USING CUSTOMPATHS:
Don't save your game with any of the paths in your chest or inventory.
If you uninstall this mod, you must first remove any paths from any place in your save, including chests/maps/inventory.

Unfortunately, these are because of the framework being used, I can't do anything about them.

This does not apply to the Alternative Textures or Content Patcher versions!

<3

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes
You can also [url=https://ko-fi.com/dotsanddashes]support [/url]me!
